author: FL Studio Plugin Deep Dives Research Team
description: Collection of optimized Dashboard configurations for different monitoring scenarios in hip-hop, rap, and R&B production

presets.name: Hip-Hop Mixing Standard
presets.description: Balanced configuration for general hip-hop mixing with focus on low-end management and vocal clarity
presets.use_case: Primary mixing setup for hip-hop tracks with balanced frequency analysis and level monitoring
benefits: Good vocal clarity in dense mixes
presets.notes: Perfect for general mixing sessions where you need to monitor both frequency content and levels simultaneously.

presets.name: Trap Production - Low-End Focus
presets.description: High-resolution configuration specifically for managing aggressive 808s and sub-bass in trap music
presets.use_case: Detailed analysis of 808s, sub-bass, and kick drum relationships in trap production
benefits: Effective phase monitoring for mono compatibility
High resolution for frequency conflict detection
presets.notes: Use this preset when working with complex 808 layers or when you need to ensure your low-end translates well to club systems.

presets.name: Rap Vocal Clarity
presets.description: Configuration optimized for monitoring rap vocal clarity, presence, and dynamic range
presets.use_case: Monitoring rap vocal presence, clarity, and ensuring they cut through dense instrumental tracks
benefits: Clear visualization of vocal presence range
Effective monitoring of rap's dynamic range
Quick detection of frequency conflicts with vocals
Fast response for dynamic rap delivery
presets.notes: Ideal for sessions where rap vocals need to maintain clarity and intelligibility in busy mixes.

presets.name: R&B Smooth Production
presets.description: Configuration for monitoring smooth R&B vocals with attention to harmonic content and spatial placement
presets.use_case: Monitoring smooth R&B vocals with harmonic richness and spatial depth
benefits: Balanced approach to frequency and level monitoring
Reduced eye strain for long sessions
presets.notes: Perfect for R&B production where smooth, warm tones and spatial depth are important.

presets.name: Hip-Hop Mastering - Safe Levels
presets.description: Configuration focused on preventing clipping and ensuring safe levels for streaming distribution
presets.use_case: Final mastering stage to ensure safe levels and prevent clipping in hip-hop masters
presets.notes: Use this preset during the final mastering stage to catch any potential clipping or phase issues.

presets.name: Hip-Hop True Peak Monitoring
presets.description: Configuration specifically for monitoring true peak levels in aggressively limited hip-hop masters
presets.use_case: Monitoring inter-sample peaks in heavily compressed and limited hip-hop masters
presets.notes: Essential for aggressive hip-hop masters that undergo heavy limiting to prevent inter-sample peaks.

presets.name: Hip-Hop Live Performance
presets.description: Configuration optimized for live hip-hop performance monitoring with quick visual feedback
presets.use_case: Live performance monitoring to prevent clipping and ensure consistent levels
benefits: Low CPU usage for live performance
presets.notes: Perfect for live hip-hop performances where quick visual feedback is essential for maintaining quality.

presets.name: Hip-Hop Arrangement Check
presets.description: Configuration for checking arrangement balance and element relationships in hip-hop compositions
presets.use_case: Analyzing arrangement balance and identifying element conflicts during composition
presets.notes: Use during arrangement phase to identify when elements are conflicting or when the mix is becoming too dense.

presets.name: Hip-Hop Stereo Imaging
presets.description: Configuration focused on stereo field monitoring and imaging for hip-hop production
presets.use_case: Monitoring stereo imaging and ensuring mono compatibility in hip-hop mixes
presets.notes: Use when placing wide elements like pads, reverbs, or stereo synths to ensure they don't cause phase issues.

presets.name: Hip-Hop Drum Mixing
presets.description: Configuration optimized for mixing hip-hop drums with focus on transient clarity and balance
presets.use_case: Mixing hip-hop drums with focus on transient clarity and pattern consistency
presets.notes: Perfect for detailed drum mixing where you need to see the shape and timing of individual hits.
